name: Design Principles for Precision
description: The course contents will include lectures & hands-on experience covering: Design principles to achieve precision; Design for stiffness; Degrees-of-Freedom and constraints, Exact-constrained design; Design of compliant mechanisms/ flexures; Constraint and mobility analysis; Friction and hysteresis; Air bearings; Dynamics; Actuators and sensors for precision application. The course contents also include different case studies and then working on different course projects identified by the students.
